description: Fix dashboard showing empty state by detecting empty/zero API responses and falling back to static mock data. Also redesign the entire dashboard with modern animations using framer-motion: glassmorphism cards, animated number counters, staggered entrance animations, hover micro-interactions, gradient accents, and smooth chart transitions.
steps: Fix `src/components/dashboard/dashboard-overview.tsx`: After successful API fetch, check if data is effectively empty (totalTrades === 0, equityCurve empty, accountCount === 0). If so, use static mock data. Replace the `generateMockEquityCurve()` function with a hardcoded static array (no Math.random) to avoid hydration mismatches.

Redesign `src/components/dashboard/dashboard-overview.tsx` with framer-motion: add staggered entrance animations to the KPI grid (motion.div with variants and staggerChildren), animate the equity curve card and recent trades card with fade-in/slide-up on mount.

Redesign `src/components/metrics/kpi-card.tsx` with modern styling: glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent bg), subtle gradient border/accent on icon area, hover scale/shadow micro-interaction using framer-motion whileHover, and an animated number counter that counts up from 0 to the target value on mount (for numeric values).

Enhance `src/components/metrics/equity-curve-chart.tsx`: wrap in a motion.div for entrance animation, ensure the gradient fill looks modern with stronger opacity, add animationBegin prop to the Area for smooth draw-in on load.
Style the Recent Trades table: add alternating row colors (even:bg-muted/50), subtle slide-in animation for each row using framer-motion, and improved spacing/typography.
Ensure all changes work in both light and dark mode (use CSS variables from tailwind config). The glassmorphism should use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-card/80 or similar transparent card backgrounds.
Run `pnpm build` to verify no TypeScript or build errors.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays meaningful mock data when API returns empty/zero results (totalTrades=0, no accounts)
Mock data is fully static (no Math.random or Date-dependent values that could cause hydration mismatch)
framer-motion is installed and used for entrance animations on KPI cards (staggered), charts (fade-in), and trade rows (slide-in)
KPI cards have glassmorphism styling (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent background) and hover micro-interactions
Animated number counter on KPI values counts up from 0
Equity curve chart has smooth entrance animation
Recent trades table has alternating row colors and row entrance animations
verification: Run `pnpm build` and confirm it completes successfully with exit code 0
findings: Build passes cleanly. All 146 tests pass. framer-motion 12.42.0 installed. Had to use 'as const' for ease property in variants to satisfy framer-motion TypeScript types. Removed unused imports (useMotionValue, useTransform, animate) from kpi-card. NODE_OPTIONS='' prefix needed for pnpm commands in this sandbox.
